notes: Same host, release builds, corpus, flags, harness and settings are required.
Time gates use medians of uninstrumented runs; resource samples never enter time medians.
Sampled resource regressions require investigation; they do not establish hard upper bounds.
Open scratch logical bytes must not exceed total input bytes in the workload; tighter worker-specific bounds are FS-16.
A noisy or unmeasurable required case is inconclusive, not a pass. Re-run the unchanged experiment.
Retain these thresholds during implementation. Any scope/gate revision requires an explicit documented decision.
Native-mode comparison requires the FS-20 adapter and equivalent artifacts. Re-run the unchanged baseline executable with that same adapter rather than comparing incompatible harnesses.
